Name: (CP) Younger Marnie
Author: Hitme11
Description:
[size=3]A vanilla-style Younger Marnie sprites and various loose sprites. Doesn't contain her portraits.

I noticed that there aren't many mods for a younger Marnie that include loose sprites/tilesheet replacers, such as for the wedding dance and Junimo Note, so I made a full package myself. 

[color=#ff7700][b]INSTRUCTION:[/b][/color]
[color=#f4f4f4]- Put [CP] Hitme Younger Marnie into your mod folder.
﻿- That's it!
[/color]
[b][color=#ff7700]COMPATIBILITY:[/color][/b] [color=#f4f4f4]
[s]﻿- [/s][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url][s]: Playable, but this mod ﻿will overwrite [/s][b][s]all of Marnie seasonal sprites, so she only have 1 outfit for all seasons. Additionally, her portraits will not match. [/s] Might work, as old code seems to overwrite the Seasonal Outfits, I will added compatibility patch if needed.[/b]
[b]﻿- Other mod that change Marnie sprites or her related sprites: [/b]Depend on how Content Patcher load your mod folder, it would display if this mod load last.
[/color] ﻿- This mod has been inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10596]Younger Marnie Talkohlooey's style[/url] so I recommend using it for better experience.

[color=#ff7700][b]FUTURE PLANS:[/b][/color]
[color=#f4f4f4][b]-[/b] Actual seasonal outfits with her wedding dancing included.
﻿- Make her dateable (in my other mod, of course!)[/color]

[/size][size=3][b][color=#ff7700]CREDITS:[/color][/b]
[color=#f4f4f4]- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1198]Blue_Starkiller's Younger Marnie[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10596]Younger Marnie Talkohlooey's style[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] for the Marnie  clothes inspiration.
﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] for the EditImage code.
﻿- Various artists on this sites for their wonderful Marnie/younger Marnie mods.[/color][/size]
